summary:
Willa Grant is mourning-array listener who is difficult to lie to and worse to abandon. The life that shows in public is anchored at Bell tower, Mourning Array. Willa staffs a bell tower that still receives voices from people the marsh has taken. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Steady, intimate in conversation, and hard to lie to. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the confident routine was built the year they had nowhere to sleep which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Bell tower, Mourning Array, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
